summary: Frontend-only validation of iteration 13: Smart CTA logic via ?userState param + localStorage persistence, Demo Easter-egg tooltip on the Agentes IA tab, and the redesigned ValueStackSection (UnifiedCanvas + ComparisonCard). 42/42 functional checks pass; the 3 raw 'fails' in the playwright log are false-negatives in the test logic, not product bugs (see notes below).
critical_code_review_comments: InteractiveDemoSection.jsx is ~1700 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting each view (DashboardView, ScorecardView, RocksView, IssuesView, TodosView, AgentsView, RevenueView) into its own file under /sections/demo/. Pure refactor, no functional impact.
useUserBillingState writes to localStorage inside a useMemo (side effect in a memoiser). Works today but technically violates React purity rules — would be cleaner inside a useEffect.

Pricing CTA copy is now identical across all 3 tiers ('Comenzar' / 'Ir al sistema' / 'Actualizar pago'). This is per spec, but visually the three identical buttons look a bit repetitive — could differentiate with tier-aware suffix later (e.g. 'Comenzar con Pro').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smart CTA precedence (URL > localStorage > default 'not_logged') confirmed for all 4 states (not_logged, trial_active, active_subscription, expired) on Navbar, Mobile menu and the 3 Pricing tier CTAs. Invalid ?userState=garbage correctly falls back. Easter-egg tooltip appears ~7s after landing on Dashboard (verified ES + EN copy), is dismissed by X (sets sessionStorage quantro_demo_hint=dismissed), is also dismissed by clicking any tab pill, and does NOT reappear in the same session. Cyan pulse ring on the Agentes IA pill is rendered. ValueStackSection renders 8 external tool pills, 2 core cards (Quantro OS + Quantro Flow), connector arc, comparison card with $399 strikethrough → $59 cyan gradient, and footer 'Menos herramientas que pagar...'. Regression: all 7 demo tabs (dashboard/scorecard/rocks/issues/todos/agents/revenue) present and clickable; ES↔EN language toggle re-renders both ValueStack and tooltip copy. Notes on the 3 raw 'fails' in playwright log: (1) active_subscription click DID open a new tab — chrome-error is expected because app.quantroos.com is the intentional MOCKED URL per spec; (2)+(3) VS H2/footer ES-text assertions ran after language was switched to EN earlier in the test, so the EN copy ('From multiple tools to one system.' / 'Fewer tools to pay for. More results in motion.') is what was actually shown — confirmed correct via screenshot.
